title: Pub dedicated to the Gravity Research Foundation

tellings.quote: you live pretty close to this pub that is uh dedicated to the grav gravity research foundation I believe uh you know this work of Roger Babson

plain: There is said to be a pub in New Hampshire dedicated to the Gravity Research Foundation, a group that, as its name says, was set up to study gravity. Michels links it to the work of a man named Roger Babson. He brings it up himself, without naming a source, while talking to Ryan Graves, a former Navy fighter pilot, and remarks that Graves lives quite close to the pub.
